name: copy-editing
description: Editing tools for prose you already have, from help articles and notices to reports and policies. A final proof that fixes only real slips, checks dates against weekdays, stated counts against lists and percentages against their total, and says whether the text can ship, naming any unapproved change from the approved version. A copyedit at the level you pick, with questions to the author instead of guesses. A style sheet and word list built from your own documents, with each variant counted and conflicting facts flagged. A cut to a word count or character limit that says what readers lose. A refresh of one published page that updates only what is dated and never invents a newer figure. Numbers, names and quotations keep their values. Checks are tuned for English.

defaultPrompt: Final proof vs approved. Approved: 'Up to 10 guests each.' Final: 'Up to 100 guests each. Doors open Thursday 4 November 2026.'
Cut to 13 words, keep times: 'Starting from next month, the office will be open from 8 am until 6 pm on weekdays only.'
Posted 10 June 2024, now 3 Oct 2026. What is stale? 'Last year we added Saturday opening. Our laser cutter arrives this autumn.'
